1.text: Haleluya! 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Yer 33.11Nimushimire Uwiteka yuko ari mwiza,Kuko imbabazi ze zihoraho iteka ryose.

2.text: Ni nde ubasha kuvuga imirimo ikomeye Uwiteka yakoze,Cyangwa kwerekana ishimwe rye ryose?

3.text: Hahirwa abitondera ibitunganye,Hahirwa ukora ibyo gukiranuka iminsi yose.

4.text: Uwiteka, nyibukana imbabazi ugirira abantu bawe,Ungendererane agakiza kawe,

5.text: Kugira ngo mbone intore zawe ziguwe neza,Nishimire umunezero w'ubwoko bwawe,Niratane n'umwandu wawe.

6.text: Twacumuranye na ba sogokuruza,Twarakiraniwe, twakoze ibyaha.

7.text: Ba sogokuruza ntibamenye ibitangaza byawe wakoreye muri Egiputa,Ntibibutse imbabazi zawe nyinshi,Ahubwo bagomera ku nyanja ari yo Nyanja Itukura.

8.text: Ariko ku bw'izina ryayo,Ibakiriza kugira ngo imenyekanishe imbaraga zayo zikomeye.

9.text: Ihana Inyanja Itukura irakama,Nuko ibacisha imuhengeri nko mu butayu.

10.text: Ibakiza ukuboko k'umwanzi wabo,Irabacungura ibakura mu kuboko k'umubisha.

12.text: Maze bizera amagambo yayo,Baririmba ishimwe ryayo.

13.text: Hahise akanya bibagirwa imirimo yakoze,Ntibarindira ko isohoza imigambi yayo.

14.text: Ahubwo bifuriza cyane mu butayu,Bageragereza Imana ahatagira abantu.

15.text: Ibaha ibyo bayisabye,Ariko imitima yabo iyishyiramo konda.

16.text: Kandi bagiririra Mose ishyari mu rugo rw'amahema,Na Aroni uwera w'Uwiteka.

17.text: Ubutaka burasama bumira Datani,Butwikīra abantu ba Abiramu.

18.text: Umuriro ucanwa mu iteraniro ryabo,Ikirimi cyawo gitwika abanyabyaha.

19.text: Baremera ikimasa i Horebu,Basenga igishushanyo kivugutiwe.

20.text: Uko ni ko baguranye icyubahiro cyabo,Bagihindura igishushanyo cy'impfizi irya ubwatsi.

21.text: Bibagirwa Imana Umukiza wabo,Yakoreye ibikomeye muri Egiputa,

22.text: Yakoreye ibitangaza mu gihugu cya Hamu,N'ibiteye ubwoba ku Nyanjya Itukura.

23.text: Bituma ivuga ko izabarimbura,Kandi iba yarabarimbuye,Iyaba Mose intore yayo atahagaze imbere yayo mu cyuho cy'inkike,Gukuraho umujinya wayo kugira ngo itabarimbura.

24.text: Kandi bagaya igihugu cy'igikundiro,Ntibizera ijambo ryayo,

25.text: Ahubwo bitotombera mu mahema yabo,Ntibumvira ijwi ry'Uwiteka.

26.text: Bituma amanika ukuboko,Abarahira yuko azabatsinda mu butayu,

27.text: Kandi azatsinda urubyaro rwabo mu mahanga,Akarutataniriza mu bihugu.

28.text: Kandi bifatanya na Bālipewori,Barya intonorano z'ibitariho.

29.text: Uko ni ko bamurakarishije imirimo yabo,Mugiga irabatungura.

30.text: Maze Finehasi arahaguruka asohoza amateka,Mugiga irashira.

31.text: Bimuhwanirizwa no gukiranuka,Kugeza ibihe by'abantu byose iteka ryose.

32.text: Kandi barakariza Uwiteka ku mazi y'i Meriba,Bituma Mose aterwa ibyago na bo.

33.text: Kuko bagomeye Umwuka w'Uwiteka,Bituma Mose avugisha akanwa ke ibidakwiriye.

37.text: Batambiraga abadayimoni abahungu babo n'abakobwa babo,

38.text: Bavushaga amaraso y'abatariho urubanza,Ni yo maraso y'abahungu babo n'ay'abakobwa babo,Batambiye ibishushanyo by'i Kanāni,Igihugu gihumanywa n'amaraso.

39.text: Nuko banduzwa n'imirimo yabo,Bagenda basambanisha ingeso zabo.

40.text: Bituma umujinya w'Uwiteka ucanwa ku bwoko bwe,Yanga urunuka umwandu we.

41.text: Abashyira mu maboko y'abanyamahanga,Abanzi babo barabatwara.

42.text: Kandi ababisha babo barabahata,Baragomorwa baba munsi y'ukuboko kwabo.

43.text: Yabakizaga kenshi,Ariko bakagomeshwa n'imigambi yabo,Bagacishwa bugufi no gukiranirwa kwabo.

44.text: Ariko yitaga ku mubabaro wabo,Uko yumvaga gutaka kwabo,

45.text: Akibuka isezerano yabasezeraniye,Akigarura nk'uko imbabazi ze nyinshi ziri,

47.text: Uwiteka Mana yacu udukize,Udutarurukanye udukure mu mahanga,Kugira ngo dushime izina ryawe ryera,Twishimire ishimwe ryawe.

48.text: Uwiteka Imana y'Abisirayeli ahimbazwe,Uhereye kera kose ukageza iteka ryose.Kandi abantu bose bavuge bati “Amen!”Haleluya.
